> Family-run bar and pool hall in South Austin with live bands, karaoke, shuffleboard and darts. Rated 4.4 from 423 Google reviews.

## About
The Stardust Club, or just "The Dust," started out as a neighborhood billiards bar and it's still family owned and family run. We're not a chain, not a franchise, and not trying to be anything we're not.
Over the decades we've added live bands, karaoke nights, shuffleboard tournaments and a big digital jukebox. Come in for a cold one after work or a night out with friends. There's something going on every night.
Folks seem to like it here. We're rated 4.4 from 423 Google reviews, and one reviewer called us a hidden gem in South Austin.

## Services
- Billiards: 14 tables, weekly tournaments, and free pool on Tuesdays. Hustler or just here for fun, there's a table for you.
- Pool leagues: Join one of our pool leagues and shoot with the regulars.
- Live Music & Entertainment: Bands every Friday and Saturday, plus a jukebox loaded with 10,000+ songs to keep the energy going.
- Karaoke night: Monday and Wednesday nights, 9 PM till close. Grab the mic and own the room.
- Games & More: Shuffleboard, darts, dominoes, indoor washer pits and more ways to keep the night moving.
- Liquor catering: Need drinks handled for a private party or an event? We can provide that service.
- Birthday and company parties: Book your birthday or company party with us. We'll reserve tables, and you can bring food and decorations.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 2:00 PM to 2:00 AM. Saturday and Sunday, 12:00 PM to 2:00 AM.

Q: When is there live music?
A: Live music every Friday, Saturday night and Sunday afternoons. When the band's done, pick a song on the jukebox.

Q: Can we bring our own food to a party?
A: Yes. Book your party with us and we can reserve tables. You can bring food and decorations.

Q: Is there somewhere to sit outside?
A: One reviewer mentions a full bar and an outdoor patio.
